models.execution_model: Eva analyzes discovered abstract entry points separately and Mthread iterates shared-write interference to a fixpoint. This is an interleaving abstraction, not the Linux Kernel Memory Model.

sequential.scope: Eva value properties inside the project-owned entry points, with Mthread enabled and the recorded options.
limitations: No arbitrary C or kernel-call acceptance follows from these controls.

mutex_protected_concurrency.scope: Mthread abstract mutex ownership and interference in project-owned pthread fixtures.
limitations: The abstract mutex is not yet connected to any configured Linux lock implementation.

interrupts.scope: Automatic handler discovery and shared-write interference from the initial main state.
limitations: Main-time lock initialization is unavailable to the automatic handler start state; nesting, IRQ classes and Linux masking are not modeled.

weak_memory_atomics.scope: No accepted C11 or Linux weak-memory atomic/barrier semantics.
limitations: Ordinary interleaving must not be presented as an LKMM or architecture memory-order proof.

rcu.scope: No accepted RCU publication, grace-period or reclamation semantics.
limitations: No-op grace periods or assumed immortal objects are forbidden for acceptance.

lock_free_algorithms.scope: No accepted lock-free functional, lifetime or progress reasoning.
limitations: Mthread's mutex-oriented race analysis is insufficient for lock-free algorithms.

pthread_create.semantics: Creates and starts a discovered Mthread abstract entry point through the bundled pthread model.
pthread_create.conservative_argument: Sufficient only for the recorded project fixtures' entry-point discovery controls.
limitations: Scheduling, termination and object lifetime are not thereby proved.

mthread_abstract_mutex.semantics: Records abstract ownership and excludes conflicting critical-section interference under the same Mthread mutex identifier.
mthread_abstract_mutex.conservative_argument: Sufficient only for assertions made while the calibrated abstract mutex is held in project-owned fixtures.
limitations: Not a model of Linux mutex, spinlock, IRQ-disable or preemption semantics.

pthread_join.semantics: The bundled stub returns a nondeterministic status and does not wait for or synchronize with the target thread.
pthread_join.conservative_argument: No completion or lifetime claim is accepted from this stub.
limitations: Successful return does not import worker completion.

interrupt_registration.semantics: Registers a named handler as an abstract concurrent entry point from the initial main state.
interrupt_registration.conservative_argument: Useful for exposing potential initial-state interference only.
limitations: Later initialization, nesting, interrupt classes and Linux masking semantics are absent.

pthread_barrier_wait.semantics: No Mthread implementation is supplied; the plugin aborts with an explicit probably-unsound diagnostic.
pthread_barrier_wait.conservative_argument: The only accepted result is detection and rejection of the unsupported primitive.
limitations: No barrier ordering or rendezvous property is modeled.
